messages.text: Which miner should I buy?
Used the purchase-research skill
Read the bsb b30 page
Read the magic miner 40t page

Depends on your budget and where it runs.

If you want the most hashrate per dollar, the Magic Miner 40T is our pick: 40 TH/s for $799, ~650W, about 50 dB. Ships November 14. The Harlo B30 is $899 for 30 TH/s at 360-450W, quieter on power, ships October 30.

The NerdQX you're looking at is the cheap way in: small, quiet, ships now, but a lot more per terahash.

What's your budget, and is it going in an office or a garage?
see same brand on Aliexpress, almost $100.00 less

Fair, and I won't pretend to match it. Our prices are as listed.

What you get here is a unit matched to your plug and voltage, our RMA and warranty handling, and a support team you can reach, plus our Discord where JD and the community help with setup. On an AliExpress unit, a dead board is your problem and your shipping cost back to China.

If you want to put the price to Georges directly, say the word and I'll bring him into this chat.
